notes: Slim broker, sold in the drop window (the Cortex mercenary store). Mercenaries for one drop: Punch of Thugs, Crash of Brutes, Hive of Wasps (very dear). Heroes for hire for one drop, metal only: Marrow Gale's Cutlasses and Bro's Tzar; win the campaign with one in the company and it is a starter from then on. Build rights: one Cortex constructor (one Armada constructor at high Armada rep). The Cortex commander suit (verdance.campaign.suits). Tenebrium is the hyper-rare build currency: it buys build rights and the suit, never mercenaries. Grunt Stream retired 2026-10-27 (Crash of Brutes back in its place).

resource.label: Tenebrium
resource.lore: Black-hole distillate metal from BAR lore. Scarce since the Generic Disaster. Build-power units cost ≥1 Tnb (ceil(buildSpeed/150)). Experimental Foundries cost 7. Named heavies stake Tnb (Sol Invictus 4, Behemoth 5, Titan 2, Juggernaut 3, Razorback 1, Thor/Catapult/Demon 2); Vanguard/Shiva/Karganeth and other combat default free. Stake lives on the unit until reclaim or vaporize. Infinite storage. Q7 is the scarcity qubit. Armada spent their stock on decoy farms — crisis, bank 0.

metal.label: Metal
metal.notes: Fresh run starts at 7×1km$. Campaign bag stays home — each sortie gets fieldStartMetalK as operating metal; floor(endMetal/1000) − fieldStart ADDS to the faction bag on extract (never replaces). Spend bag km$ in hub shop. Not a substitute for Tenebrium on build gear.

punch_of_thugs.label: Punch of Thugs
punch_of_thugs.blurb: Pawn launcher salvo: 7 Cortex Thugs land with your infil. Chaff to throw in front of your heroes. Buy again to stack.

recommend.why: Two Punches make the first raid on Greenest Fields far kinder.

crash_of_brutes.label: Crash of Brutes
crash_of_brutes.blurb: Armor column: four Cortex Brutes roll in from the Eye of Horus mid-sortie.

wasp_flight.label: Hive of Wasps
wasp_flight.blurb: Cortex mercenary gunships: four Wasp gunships flying as one hive, hired by the sortie and priced like it. They arrive from the Eye of Horus mid-sortie.

rent_gale.label: Rent Marrow Gale · Cutlass wing
rent_gale.blurb: Cortex lends you Marrow Gale and six Cutlass seaplanes for one drop, for a great deal of metal. Win the campaign with Gale in your company and Gale is yours to start with from then on.

rent_bro.label: Rent Bro · the Tzar
rent_bro.blurb: Cortex lends you Bro and his Tzar for one drop, for a fortune in metal. Win the campaign with Bro in your company and Bro is yours to start with from then on.

cortex_constructor.label: Cortex Constructor
cortex_constructor.blurb: Buy the right to build — one Cortex construction bot for the kit.

cortex_commander_suit.label: Cortex Commander Suit (one fight)
cortex_commander_suit.blurb: Cortex will loan you a commander suit for one fight, and they want an outrageous price for it. It goes back to them when you come home. You need a suit to duel in All That Simmers. Wear theirs and Cortex won't turn up for that fight.

armada_constructor.label: Armada Constructor
armada_constructor.blurb: High Armada reputation opens their construction bots. Costs Tenebrium.

metalOnVictory.notes: A won sortie adds a flat 1k. Most campaign metal comes from the stockpile you extract with (metalOnExtract): build metal storage and reclaim everything before you lift. Tenebrium never comes from mission outcomes or captured ground; only from reclaim.

metalOnExtract.notes: The primary source of campaign metal (and so of the mercenary store): floor(end stockpile / 1000), less the field's starting allotment. Metal storage raises what you can carry out; reclaim fills it.
